annotations.title: Run a command with vault secrets

description: Run a command on this machine (tests, a migration, a deploy script) WITH the project's secrets from the NoData vault as environment variables — without you seeing them. The secrets are pulled into memory only (no .env is written); you get back the exit code and the output with every secret value blanked. EVERY command needs the user's approval, as written. When a key's policy says a person approves each use, or the client cannot ask the user itself, NoData asks the person: a page opens in their browser (or give them the link this returns), they sign in, check the command and the code, and approve it there — you cannot approve it, and there is no code for you to send back. Then call nodata_run again with the same command, folder and project; it resumes the same request. Never embed a secret value in the command, never try to print or encode one, and never confirm on the user's behalf. Uses this computer's NoData connection (`npx -y @nodatachat/mcp connect`, approved once in the browser) — no separate token; a project-limited CLI token saved with `secrets-login` is used first if present. Never ask the user for a key in the chat.

approval.description: Optional: the approval id NoData returned for this exact command. It releases nothing by itself — only a person's approval of this command at NoData does.

command.description: The exact command line to run, e.g. `npm test`.

cost_usd.description: Optional: this run's price in dollars, as you showed it to the user. A key whose rule caps its daily spend counts it and refuses a run that states none. State the real price; it is kept on the receipt.

cwd.description: Folder to run in. Default: the current folder.

partner_of.description: Optional: a CLIENT organisation's id — run with that client's keys, as its partner. The client's own key board decides each key (only a rule naming this computer releases one; its admins approve, never you). Needs a Connect connection from the client to this computer.

project.description: Secrets project label. Default: the token's project (a connected computer has none: name it).

name: nodata_run
